title: zh-CN: list grid date cells render English month abbreviations ("Oct 11", "Nov 1") while the same record's page renders 2026年10月11日
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcUoS2G4jgqRskpExS7

Found in the 18.3.0 release-candidate browser walkthrough (wave anchor #27377, card W3-UX), at framework `main` @ `c4c515ad`, Console built in-repo from the same commit.

## Repro (fresh boot)

1. Boot `examples/app-showcase` with `--seed-admin` and sign in as admin. Viewport 1440×900.
2. Open the avatar menu → **Language** → **中文（中国）**.
3. Open **功能展示 → 任务** (All Tasks).

## Expected

The 截止日期 column is formatted for zh-CN, consistent with the record page.

## Actual

Every cell reads `Oct 11`, `Nov 1`, `Nov 18` and so on, under Chinese column headers, status chips and footer (`10 条记录`). The same task's record page shows `2026年10月11日`.

Also on that screen, the object description under the title stays English: `A unit of work inside a project.`. That may be the showcase bundle's coverage rather than the platform. The other English leftovers seen under zh-CN were showcase example content (dashboard KPI captions and axis titles on Delivery Operations, the search group `Account (Success Overlay)`), so they are not raised here.

Related, closed: #25884 (one date column mixing relative and absolute formats).
